comparison.objective: Insert the final motor magnet while preventing an adjacent loose magnet from jumping out; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR holds one magnet down while aligning and inserting another against modeled magnetic forces. Candidate uses a hex bit and rotating collar, then runs a physical impact fixture.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the correct magnet flush, adjacent magnet displacement ≤6 mm, and arms returned. Candidate requires locked retention and two safe stopping cycles.
comparison.reason: Force-coupled bimanual insertion is materially different from fastener/collar manipulation and measured damper tuning.
